description: Start a chunked asset upload. Use this instead of upload_asset's fileBase64 param for large files over the remote/HTTP transport, where a single large base64 string can get truncated crossing the LLM→tool_call boundary. Flow: upload_asset_begin (once) → upload_asset_chunk (once per chunk, in order) → upload_asset_finish (once). Returns an uploadId that expires after 10 minutes of inactivity.

fileName.description: Original file name including extension, e.g. 'logo.png'.

fileSize.description: Raw decoded byte length of the original file. Recommended — enables truncation/corruption detection at finish time.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the file, e.g. 'image/png'

sha256.description: Sha256 hex digest of the original file's decoded bytes. Recommended — enables end-to-end integrity verification at finish time.

name: upload_asset_begin
